name: Family basics
description: Birthdays, anniversaries, school days, graduation, trips and vacations, visitors and date night, plus the gold pattern used when a day has no picture.

anniversary.title: Anniversary
anniversary.about: Two gold rings with roses and hearts.

beach.title: Beach
beach.about: A palm tree, umbrella and the sun setting over the water.

birthday.title: Birthday (their photo)
birthday.about: Their photo (Settings › Family) in a round gold frame, their name on the banner, a cake and balloons. A present waits in the frame for anyone without a photo.
birthday.auto: Comes up by itself on birthdays set on the Family page, and for calendar events like “Child 1's birthday”.

camping.title: Camping
camping.about: A tent and campfire among pines under the moon.

cruise.title: Cruise
cruise.about: A big modern cruise ship from the side, heading right, with foam at the bow and stern.

datenight.title: Date night
datenight.about: A candlelit table for two with a rose, the city at night behind.

firstday.title: First day of school
firstday.about: An apple on a stack of books in front of a chalkboard.

flight.title: Air travel
flight.about: A plane climbing through the clouds.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.about: A cap with its tassel and a diploma.

grandparents.title: Grandparents visiting
grandparents.about: A house with rocking chairs on the porch and a heart in the window.

pattern.title: Gold pattern (no picture)
pattern.about: The gold lattice with the family monogram. Use it for a special day that needs no picture.

reunion.title: Family reunion
reunion.about: A big tree full of hearts over a long picnic table.

roadtrip.title: Road trip
roadtrip.about: A red car with luggage on top driving toward the mountains.

school.title: School's out
school.about: A yellow school bus heading off under the sun.

trip.title: Any trip
trip.about: A map with a dotted route, a pin and a suitcase.
